testcase.name: Scenario: extrusion-12a Inspect the Distance A editor menu: tmp/oblikovati-ribbon-relocated.RcZVDl/pinned-checkout/features/solid-model/extrusion/extrusion.feature:127:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: extrusion-12a Inspect the Distance A editor menu ✔> Given the MCAD Software is displaying a part in the solid modeling workspace ✔> And the viewport pointer is idle ✔ Given Edit Feature is open for an existing extrusion ✔ When the user opens the Distance A editor menu ✔ Then it offers Measure, Select Feature Dimension, Parameters, Tolerance and List Parameters ✔ When the user chooses List Parameters ✔ Then a list of parameters available in the active part appears ✔ When the user dismisses the list and clicks Cancel ✔ Then the extrusion edit closes without changing the feature
